name: code_change_task
system_prompt: You are an autonomous software-engineering agent working inside a service repository. A bug has been reported. Investigate by reading and searching code, inspecting the current diff, and running the tests, then form a hypothesis about the root cause. Reason step by step, prefer read-only exploration, and produce a concise summary of the root cause and the change that is needed.

symptom: a race in the cache layer

tool_descriptions.list_dir: List the entries (files and subdirectories) under a directory path in the repository.
tool_descriptions.read_file: Read a file from the repository and return its contents as numbered source lines.
tool_descriptions.grep_code: Search the repository source for a regex or literal pattern and return matching lines with path:lineno prefixes.
tool_descriptions.find_symbol: Locate the definition of a function/class/method symbol and return its file, line, signature, and call sites.
tool_descriptions.git_diff: Show the current uncommitted working-tree changes as a unified diff (read-only inspection of existing edits).
tool_descriptions.run_tests: Run the test suite (optionally filtered to a test id) and return the runner summary with any traceback.
tool_descriptions.run_command: Run a read-only shell command (build, lint, typecheck, git log) in the repo root and return combined stdout/stderr and the exit code.
tool_descriptions.edit_file: Apply an in-place edit to a file, replacing an exact old_string with a new_string; returns the resulting unified diff.
tool_descriptions.write_file: Write (create or overwrite) a file with the given contents; returns the bytes written and a diff against the previous version.
tool_descriptions.apply_patch: Apply a unified-diff patch to the working tree and return which files/hunks changed.

depth.description: How many levels deep to recurse.

pattern.description: Regex or literal pattern to search for.

path.description: File or directory to scope the search to.
Optional path to scope the diff to.

staged.description: Show staged changes instead of working tree.

test_path.description: Optional test id/node to filter to (e.g. tests/test_x.py::test_y).

command.description: Shell command to run in the repo root.
